nodes.description: The five stops. Each one you pass replaces the default for that stop. A node is { label, meta?, detail?, icon?, color? }: meta is the resting second line, detail is the hover tag, icon is SVG path data on a 24 by 24 viewBox painted in color, an image URL, or any ReactNode. The merchant's second line always shows the balance.

amount.description: The charge, shown on the chip that travels to the bank.

fee.description: What the processor keeps at settlement. The payout is amount minus fee.

balance.description: Merchant balance before the first payout. It grows by the payout on every loop.

currency.description: ISO currency code for every amount.

locale.description: Locale for money formatting. Keep it fixed so the server and the browser agree.

authorizationMs.description: Authorization time the step row counts to, in milliseconds.

labels.description: Phase names in the step row, when settlement happens, and the text on the approval chip.

hideSteps.description: Hides the step row and shows only the diagram.

speed.description: Multiplies the pace. At 1 one payment takes about 15 seconds. 0 holds still.

paused.description: Holds the diagram still where it is, easing to rest instead of stopping in one frame.

accent.description: Color of the moving amount, the active path, the settlement rail, and hovered wires. Defaults to the accent token. Approval and settled states stay semantic success.

label.description: Accessible description of the diagram. Built from the nodes and amounts when left out.

caption.description: Optional visible caption under the diagram, rendered as a figcaption.

style.description: Inline styles on the root figure.
